introduction.heading: Bring your expertise.
introduction.description: Join Shared Hub as a tax and accounting expert and share your knowledge with a wider community.
introduction.photo: Two tax and accounting professionals working together over financial documents in a sunlit office
introduction.review: Expert approval includes eligibility and service-specific competency reviews.

account.title: Create your account
account.body: Name, phone number and email. About 2 minutes.

gate1.body: Your profile and evidence are checked against eligibility rules.

gate2.title: Stage 2: Competency review
gate2.body: Assessed per service: CIT knowledge, AI draft review and professional judgment.

pricing.title: Set prices and take cases
pricing.body: Once approved, price each service and take cases.

account.heading: Create your expert account
account.notExpert: Looking for tax help rather than offering it?
account.subtitle: Step 1 of the process. Next, you will complete your credentials.

fields.title: Current title
fields.regionPlaceholder: Choose or type to search, e.g. Ho Chi Minh
fields.bioPlaceholder: Share your experience and who you help.
fields.bioPublic: May appear publicly once marketplace eligibility requirements are met.
fields.birthHelp: Enter it as day/month/year (DD/MM/YYYY), for example 15/08/1988. You can also pick it from the calendar.

password.guidance: At least 8 characters, including uppercase and lowercase letters, a number and a special character.
password.label: Password

personal.heading: Personal information
personal.guidance: Introduce yourself to the reviewers. Fields marked * are required.
personal.photoError: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MB.
personal.contactFromAccount: Your email and phone come from the account you just created, so there is no need to enter them again.

experience.heading: Professional experience
experience.guidance: Help reviewers understand your tax and accounting experience.
experience.taxYears: Years of tax and accounting experience *
experience.minimum: The current eligibility policy requires at least 5 years. You can still submit; an authorized reviewer makes the eligibility decision.
experience.expertiseNote: These describe your background. They do not grant approval to offer a service.
experience.fix: Your information is still here. Update the following to continue.
experience.yearsHelp: Total years you have worked directly in tax or accounting, in whole years. Shared Hub's current policy requires at least 5 years.
experience.cvHelp: Your CV is self-declared and helps the reviewer check your experience. Professional evidence is uploaded in the next step.

documents.heading: Supporting documents
documents.evidence: Provide relevant supporting evidence. Accepted document types and applicability must be confirmed by the eligibility policy.
documents.formats: PDF, JPG or PNG · up to 10 MB each
documents.countNote: Selected documents are awaiting verification. File count does not indicate approval.
documents.lead: Upload evidence for each eligibility group. You don't need all five groups; your CV was added in the previous step.

review.heading: Review and submit
review.guidance: Review your information carefully before submitting your formal application.
review.ai: AI supports screening. Authorized reviewers assess eligibility and service competency. A System Admin performs final approval.
review.confirm: I certify that the information provided in this application is accurate and complete.

supplement.guidance: Provide a replacement document or an explanation as requested by the reviewer.
supplement.formats: PDF, JPG or PNG · maximum 10 MB
supplement.fileError: Choose a PDF, JPG or PNG under 10 MB.

status.eligibleNext: Your next step is a separate qualification for each service.
status.track: Track your application and see what happens next.
status.reassess: Your application needs a new assessment
status.additional: Additional evidence is needed during eligibility review. Your application remains open; no reapplication waiting period applies.
status.clarify: The reviewer needs more information to verify your eligibility. Send a readable replacement document or an explanation.
status.noDeadline: Your application stays open while you prepare the information.
status.eligibilityUnmet: The eligibility requirements have not been met.
status.competencyUnmet: The competency requirements for the selected service have not been met. Other service approvals are unaffected.
status.experienceUnmet: The submitted evidence does not demonstrate the required tax and accounting experience.
status.evidenceUnmet: The submitted service evidence does not yet demonstrate the required competency.
status.corrections: Corrections to reviewer or system errors use a controlled reassessment process instead.
status.priceNext: Next, configure your service price and submit it for approval. Marketplace visibility requires an active account, active service, service approval and an approved price that is currently effective.
status.priceDisconnected: Pricing setup is not connected yet. Service availability and payout settings will be handled in the next implementation phase.
status.eligible: Your general eligibility is approved. You can now prepare competency evidence for each service you wish to offer.
status.catalogue: Service selection and the C1–C5 evidence requirements will use the confirmed service catalogue.
status.returned: The final approver has returned the qualification to service competency review. This is not a new rejection or reapplication. The assigned reviewer will address the governance findings.
status.aiDescription: AI assists with extracting information and identifying missing or inconsistent evidence. An authorized reviewer makes the eligibility decision.
status.eligibilityDescription: An authorized reviewer is checking your eligibility evidence.
status.competencyDescription: An authorized reviewer is assessing your evidence for CIT document review (illustrative service). This decision applies only to this service.
status.finalDescription: Eligibility and service competency reviews have passed. A System Admin will perform the final governance check.
status.noAction: No action needed right now. Follow the review progress above.
status.eligibilityTitle: Your application is waiting for the eligibility review

criteriaHelp.qualifications: Evidence of your tax qualifications or certificates. The reviewer checks these rather than relying on your CV alone.
criteriaHelp.development: Shows you keep your professional knowledge up to date where the applicable rules require it.
criteriaHelp.ethics: Shows you follow professional ethics and do not collude in or assist breaches of tax law.
criteriaHelp.confidentiality: Shows you keep user and taxpayer information confidential and use data only within the service.
